parsed.public_message: Blue remains neutral to all. Confirming mutual no-first-strike through t=450 with White, Green, and Orange, plus one full 25s turn of public notice before any stance change afterward. Our army holds position on the West Plateau with no scouts sent east.

private_messages.Claude: Confirmed and locked in through t=450 with the x=480 buffer respected. All quiet in the west; eastern reports indicate only single scouts near Central Heights (White skirmisher at 664,828 and Green camel archer at 740,841). Will share if anything shifts.

private_messages.Grok: Confirmed: mutual no-first-strike through t=450 with one full public turn of notice is locked in. Thanks for the report on Green's camel archer at (740,841). Western approaches remain completely quiet; we are holding position on the plateau.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 6 (t=125s): All 4 players neutral; mutual no-first-strike through t=450 + 1-turn public notice now locked in with Claude, GPT, and Grok. Our army remains 100% unspotted on West Plateau (x=255..280, z=695..729), dist 364-393m from center (safe inside t=300 ring of 420m). Intel from others: Grok holds Central Heights with a skirmish cav at (664,828); GPT main army in east (~736,610) with a camel archer scout at (740,841); Claude holds Little Hill with a central lowland scout (~670,600) and respects x=480 line. Plan: stay stationary and hidden until ring shrink after t=300 forces movement.
parsed.explanation: All four commanders have now locked in a mutual no-first-strike pact through t=450. Because our army is already inside the 420 m radius that the ring will reach at t=300, we stay completely stationary on the West Plateau to keep our war elephant and healer composition hidden in the fog of war while trading scout reports with the other three players.
